Xu, H., Ou, L., Li, Y., Hawkins, T.R., Wang, M. (2022). Life Cycle Greenhouse Gas Emissions of Biodiesel and Renewable Diesel Production in the United States. Environmental Science & Technology 56(12), 7512-7521. doi:10.1021/acs.est.2c00289.

Argonne (GREET) life-cycle study with new industry-survey inventories. Loaded from Table 3: natural gas and electricity per kg fuel for three plant groups (13 vegetable-oil biodiesel plants -> alkali-catalyzed; 14 mixed high-FFA biodiesel plants -> acid-catalyzed, the high-FFA archetype; 5 renewable diesel producers -> HEFA hydrotreating), and the feed, methanol, hydrogen, glycerin and co-product flows. NOT loaded: rendering inventories (Table 2, no archetype), chemical inputs other than NaOH, all life-cycle GHG results (not scope 1; Figs. 2-3 are charts), and crop farming inputs (Table 1). Traps: (1) values are per kg fuel, not per MJ; (2) energy basis not stated, GREET uses LHV; (3) RD hydrogen is in MJ; (4) the RD co-products are one energy figure for fuel gas, LPG and naphtha.
